scope: Targeted identity review for the 11 unique unresolved exact-name National Partnership overlaps across the 2022 Overture 15 negative-vote roster and NAE-withdrawal protest roster.
method: Each decision joins an explicit National Partnership membership record to one or both official 2022 PCA action rosters only where office/presbytery continuity or independently documented ministry history supports the person-level match. Historical presbytery changes and questionable source labels are preserved rather than normalized away. This receipt establishes identity only; NP membership, recorded voting, and protest signing remain separately sourced actions.
guardrails: Exact-name overlap alone is not sufficient for a canonical identity decision.
A reviewed identity does not convert a person into a generic ideological label; it connects separately documented actions to the same person.
Historical presbytery changes are retained as dated facts rather than treated as contradictions or silently overwritten.

Jeremy Fair's 2019 NP presbytery label is preserved as printed even though official 2019 PCA evidence places him in Hills and Plains; the identity decision does not certify the NP label as current or accurate.
Justin Edgar's 2018 NP source label 'Build That Wall Presbytery' is preserved as archival wording and is not treated as a real PCA presbytery name.
No global name-matching threshold is relaxed by these person-specific decisions.
